value.summary: Management displays high operational discipline and transparency, consistently meeting its commitments on wage adjustments, talent scaling, and specific sector turnarounds. While maintaining an ambitious long-term margin aspiration of 26% to 28%, leadership candidly communicates near-term margin constraints stemming from strategic investments and subcontractor costs.

promises.quote: you should expect a similar impact on what we have seen in the past annual increment cycle, which had been in the range of 150 to 200 basis points.
promises.promised: Wage increment impact on Q1 FY27 operating margins guided to be between 150 and 200 basis points.
promises.actual_delivered: In Q1 FY27, annual increments impacted operating margins by 170 basis points (Jul 2026 transcript, page 5).
promises.reasoning: The actual margin headwind of 170 bps fell precisely within management's expected range of 150 to 200 bps.

promises.quote: We have announced annual salary increments for our eligible associates across all grades, effective April 1.
promises.promised: Annual salary increments across all eligible grades to be executed effective April 1.
promises.actual_delivered: Completed salary increments globally across all associates in Q1 FY27 (Jul 2026 transcript, page 8).
promises.reasoning: Management followed through and completed the global annual salary rollouts during Q1.

promises.quote: Manufacturing, we believe will turn around in Q2, life sciences could turn around in Q2, tech services will continue to grow.
promises.promised: Manufacturing and Life Sciences to stage a turnaround in Q2 FY27, while Tech Services continues to grow.
promises.actual_delivered: In Q2 FY27, Manufacturing grew 3.1% QoQ CC, Tech and Services grew 3.1% QoQ CC, and Life Sciences grew 0.3% QoQ CC after declining in Q1 (Oct 2026 transcript, pages 10-11).
promises.reasoning: All three verticals executed in accordance with management's turnaround and growth expectations.

guidance.target: Dilution of about 50 basis points from the MHP acquisition depending on closing and integration timing.
guidance.quote: The acquisition-related dilution, particularly in MHP , is likely to impact by about 50 basis points depending on the timing of closure and when the integration starts.

guidance.target: Long-term aspirational operating margin band remains 26% to 28%.
guidance.quote: Overall, our long-term aspiration remains unchanged, continues to be 26% to 28%.

guidance.target: Revenues from data center capacity expansion to start kicking in within 18 to 24 months.
guidance.quote: And it will take about 18 to 24 months before the revenues start kicking in.

guidance.target: Furloughs in Q3 FY27 expected to track historical seasonality without material variance.
guidance.quote: And in Q3, so far from what we are seeing, the furlough will be very similar to the previous years. We don't see any major change.

bull.point: Annualized AI services revenue has expanded rapidly to over $3.1 billion, accounting for more than 10% of total revenue.
bull.quote: Annualized AI revenue reached $3.1 billion and crossed 10% of our overall revenue.

bull.point: Order book momentum remains solid with Q2 TCV reaching $9.6 billion, excluding significant deals like Porsche and Best Buy.
bull.quote: Third, our order book remained healthy. TCV for the quarter was US$9.6 billion. This excludes the Porsche and Best Buy deals.

bull.point: Cash generation remains exceptionally strong, with operating cash conversion exceeding 100% of net profits.
bull.quote: Our cash conversion remains strong at 102.2% of net income and funds invested at the end of the period stood at $5.98 billion.

bear.point: Near-term operating margins are pressured by increased subcontracting costs, bench creation, and upcoming M&A dilution.
bear.quote: As we build future capacity and navigate demand transitions, we have invested in a higher bench and increased hiring of subcontractors to meet near-term skills and delivery requirements.

bear.point: Discretionary IT spending remains constrained by persistent macroeconomic scrutiny and lack of immediate ROI.
bear.quote: The demand environment has not materially changed since last quarter, and discretionary programs without near-term value remain under scrutiny.

bear.point: Consumer-facing verticals face sustained weakness from inflation, cost pressures, and client insourcing.
bear.quote: Consumer Business declined by 0.7% sequentially and 1% year-on-year. Retail and consumer products remain sensitive to inﬂation, energy costs, and selective consumer spending.
